en: Black‑and‑white view of a large wooden public building with a steep metal roof and central cupola, standing in an open grassy field. Small groups of people, possibly children and adults, gather in front of the structure. Surrounding it are other wooden houses and, in the distant right background, a tall church with a pointed spire. The architecture and setting suggest a small Northern European town or village in the early 20th century. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the front.
